skill.name: busco-phylogeny
skill.description: Generate phylogenies from genome assemblies using BUSCO/compleasm single-copy orthologs and scheduler-aware workflows.
skill.summary: Build reproducible genome-to-tree workflows for local, SLURM, and PBS environments.
skill.author: brunoasm

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are benign workflow syntax, documentation markup, fixed relative paths, or safe argument-list subprocess calls. Confirmed risks include eval-based command injection, unverified executable downloads, and predictable shared temporary directories. No prompt injection, credential collection, or data-exfiltration intent was found. Static review was capped at 400/549 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 149 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: run_aliscore.sh executes a command string containing user-controlled values with eval.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the command string with a Bash array, validate numeric options, and pass every filename or option as a quoted array element.

remediation.issue: Installation instructions download executable scripts, archives, and installers without integrity checks.
remediation.suggestion: Pin immutable commits or releases, publish SHA-256 checksums, verify every artifact before use, and prefer signed package-manager distributions.

remediation.issue: Manual installation examples reuse and recursively delete /tmp/phylo_downloads.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private directory with mktemp -d, set restrictive permissions, and remove only the captured path through a cleanup trap.

content.user_title: Build BUSCO Phylogenies from Genome Assemblies
content.value_statement: Genome-to-tree phylogenomics requires many tools, file transformations, and scheduler settings. This skill creates a tailored BUSCO/compleasm workflow with scripts, quality checks, tree inference, and methods text.
actual_capabilities: Queries NCBI assemblies by taxon and filters results by assembly level, annotation, RefSeq status, and contig N50.
Downloads selected NCBI genomes through the datasets CLI and prepares accession-based inputs.
Generates local, SLURM, or PBS scripts for compleasm, alignment, trimming, partition search, and gene-tree inference.
Extracts single-copy orthologs, creates QC summaries, and converts FASconCAT partition data for IQ-TREE.
Supports trimAl, ClipKit, BMGE, or Aliscore/ALICUT trimming workflows.
Produces concatenated and ASTRAL tree workflows plus a customized publication methods paragraph.
limitations: Requires external bioinformatics tools, a supported scheduler or local shell, and adequate compute resources.
Does not complete an analysis without user-provided genomes, taxonomy, resources, and software choices.
Network-dependent steps require NCBI access and may download third-party tools or reference data.
Generated scripts require review because file paths, scheduler policies, software versions, and dataset sizes vary.

use_cases.title: Plan a Comparative Genomics Study
use_cases.description: Turn selected genome assemblies into a documented ortholog, alignment, trimming, and tree-inference workflow.

use_cases.title: Prepare Cluster Jobs
use_cases.description: Generate resource-aware SLURM or PBS scripts with array jobs for large genome and locus collections.

use_cases.title: Learn Phylogenomics
use_cases.description: Follow each genome-to-tree stage with quality thresholds, method choices, expected outputs, and publication guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Local Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a local BUSCO phylogeny workflow for [taxon] using [genome paths]. Ask for missing lineage, CPU, memory, and trimming choices.

prompt_templates.title: Select NCBI Assemblies
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to [count] NCBI assemblies for [taxon]. Prioritize [quality criteria], show quality metrics, and prepare selected accessions for download.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Cluster Scripts
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate SLURM scripts for [genome count] genomes using [BUSCO lineage], [CPU count] CPUs, [memory], and [walltime]. Use array jobs where appropriate.

prompt_templates.title: Design and Validate an Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and validate a complete workflow for [taxon]. Compare [trimming methods], test [model set], infer concatenated and ASTRAL trees, and draft methods text.

output_examples.input: Build a local workflow for 12 fungal genomes with 24 CPUs and the fungi BUSCO lineage.
output_examples.output: A staged local workflow covers environment setup, compleasm runs, QC, ortholog extraction, MAFFT alignment, trimming, IQ-TREE inference, ASTRAL, and methods text.

output_examples.input: Find chromosome-level RefSeq assemblies for Felidae and show contig N50 values.
output_examples.output: A ranked assembly table presents accessions, organism names, assembly levels, annotation status, and contig N50 values for selection.

output_examples.input: Prepare SLURM jobs for 40 insect genomes with 128 CPUs and 16 CPUs per compleasm job.
output_examples.output: Scheduler-ready stages include the first lineage-download job, parallel genome arrays, locus arrays, resource settings, logs, and downstream dependencies.

best_practices: Review generated paths, resource requests, software versions, and scheduler directives before execution.
Use consistent sample names and retain accession mappings, QC reports, logs, parameters, and intermediate files.
Pin and verify downloaded tools, then test the workflow on a small genome subset before scaling.
anti_patterns: Do not mix unrelated BUSCO lineages or inconsistent assembly-quality thresholds without documenting the rationale.
Do not submit large job arrays before validating one genome and one locus end to end.
Do not run mutable downloaded scripts or installers without version pinning and integrity verification.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: Provide local genome FASTA paths, NCBI assembly accessions, BioProject accessions, or a combination of these inputs.

faq.question: Which execution environments are supported?
faq.answer: The templates support local Bash, GNU parallel, SLURM, and PBS/Torque workflows.

faq.question: Does the skill download data or software?
faq.answer: Optional steps use the NCBI datasets CLI and may retrieve scientific tools or reference data from external sources.

faq.question: How is the BUSCO lineage selected?
faq.answer: Choose the narrowest appropriate OrthoDB lineage that covers the study taxa, then confirm availability in compleasm.

faq.question: Which trimming methods are available?
faq.answer: The workflow supports trimAl, ClipKit, BMGE, and Aliscore with ALICUT.

faq.question: What final outputs are produced?
faq.answer: Outputs include QC summaries, alignments, a supermatrix, partition definitions, gene trees, concatenated trees, an ASTRAL tree, and methods text.
